name: plugin-creator
description: Create and validate Ephe plugins: manifest scaffolds, permission reviews, signing guidance.

commands.name: newplugin
commands.template: Create an ephe-plugin.json scaffold for: {input}. Manifest v1, slug from a-z0-9-, minimal tool families, commands with templates. Name the validation (ephe plugin list) and the signing step.

commands.name: validateplugin
commands.description: Check a plugin manifest against the schema
commands.template: Check the plugin in {input} against the manifest contract (v1, slug, SemVer, tool families, SKILL.md attachments) and return a repair list.
